criteria.text: app.New performs no synchronous Signet network connection.
Each Signet client reconnects using bounded attempts, backoff, jitter, and fresh deadline-free connection lifetime contexts.
Disconnected signing fails explicitly and readiness is degraded with connection diagnostics while liveness stays healthy.
Soul Factory waits for signing readiness and replays queued history without repeating terminal work.
The OpenClaw sidecar readiness signal requires capability publication and subscription EOSE.
